# Daggerheart Atlas

A bilingual (RU/EN) field guide to environments — scenes and hazards — for the
Daggerheart tabletop RPG. Each entry carries a tier, difficulty, terrain
biome(s), narrative impulses, potential adversaries, and GM-facing features.

- Catalog (interactive, JavaScript-rendered): https://machenspieler.github.io/daggerheart-codex/
- Full environment data (canonical, machine-readable): https://machenspieler.github.io/daggerheart-codex/data/environments.json
- Region groupings: https://machenspieler.github.io/daggerheart-codex/data/regions.json
- UI strings / label translations: https://machenspieler.github.io/daggerheart-codex/data/i18n.json

The catalog page is a client-rendered single-page app, so the JSON files above
are the most reliable way to read its content programmatically — they are the
source the page itself is built from, not a derived export.
